description: Migrate a production database from Oracle 19c to PostgreSQL 16 for a high-traffic e-commerce application. The database is 2TB with 500 tables, 200 stored procedures, and 50 materialized views. The migration must follow this sequence: schema conversion (Oracle data types to Postgres, sequences, triggers), type mapping validation (NUMBER to NUMERIC, DATE to TIMESTAMP, CLOB to TEXT), data migration via AWS DMS or ora2pg, dual-write shadow period (application writes to both Oracle and Postgres, reads from Oracle), reconciliation check (row counts, checksum comparison), cutover (switch reads and writes to Postgres), verify, and retire Oracle. A rollback plan must exist (fail back to Oracle, replay dual-write buffer). Risk factors: stored procedure dialect differences (PL/SQL to PL/pgSQL), performance regressions (query plans differ), and data type precision loss. Tools available: ora2pg, AWS DMS, pgAdmin, SQL Developer, psql, application feature flags.
